title: Education & EdTech
tagline: Learning platforms, university portals, and exam resources
description: Open educational resources from OLE Nepal, government e-learning (Sikai Chautari), and a thriving private EdTech sector (Kullabs, Saralnotes, mySecondTeacher, Mero School). University and exam portals are mostly form-based.
